notes.title: Pandemic Express is now free
notes.content:
Pandemic Express, the survival shooter where you try to outrun a player-controlled swarm of infected, is going free to play!

[previewyoutube=qYhzmJNKzUg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Going Free To Play in a nutshell:[/h1]
[list][*] Pandemic Express is now free
[*] You earn stars for playing matches
[*] You can spend these stars on costumes, emojis, and in-game music
[*] If you don’t have enough time to earn stars, you can simply buy them
[*] All original buyers of the game are getting 2,000 stars to buy whatever you want -- thank you so much for being with us from the start!
[/list]
We believe this is the most fair and transparent way to do free to play. Tell us what you think in the comments!

[h2]Free Music For Everyone Who Bought The Game![/h2]

To celebrate going Free To Play, we are giving everyone who originally bought the game all in-game music tracks! 

In-game music is the jukebox you carry around in the beginning of the match. By choosing your own music, you set the theme for the whole match. Unless you get eaten by zombies of course. 

[h2]About Pandemic Express:[/h2]

Pandemic Express is a zombie escape game. You play as a human, but when you die, the match isn’t over for you — you come back as a zombie to hunt down the rest of the humans.

Your goal as a human is to loot up and get on a train, then ride on that train out of the zombies’ lair to safety, while the zombies attack you from all the directions, pulling the humans one by one away from the train.

You won’t survive alone, so it’s best to stay in small groups. Ideal scenario — you and your mates get into a van and drive it to a weapon drop location to get the best guns. Then, once you’re battle-ready, get on that train and defend it.

Guns have two purposes — defense and utility/parkour. You can bounce off any surface using your guns — just walk up to a wall and fire a burst at the right angle — and you’ll get up that wall, all the way to the roof. There are also double jumps and bounce pads — all of this combined allows an experienced player to traverse the map like a ninja, hopping from a rooftop to a tree crown to another rooftop.

After you die, you get to choose one of the three zombie classes. Each has a unique flavor — one allows you to swallow humans and spit them out away from the train, another one — to mimic humans, blending in with them to deal a devastating blow.

[h2]Easy to Learn, Hard to Master[/h2]

The asymmetrical PvP provides fun for players of all skill levels — if you can’t fend off a bunch of zombies on your own yet, you can have fun chasing veteran survivors as a zombie and get rewarded for it.

Movement is one of the most crucial skills in Pandemic Express — learning how to bunnyhop and gun-jump efficiently can make all the difference in a match.

Practice a bit in the training mode or check out this starter’s guide:

[previewyoutube=JJtfWsnU9qY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Community[/h2]

Pandemic Express has a very tight-knit community. They hang out in our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/pandemicexpress]Discord[/url], create amazing [url=https://www.facebook.com/pandemicexpressgame/posts/244728699794348]fan art[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vCLTkU4TVTs&feature=youtu.be]animations[/url], and recently some community-made emojis made it into the game!

notes.title: Achievements, Music and Emotes — Update 29/12/2019
notes.content:

Long time no see! This is the last update for Pandemic Express this year, but not the last one ever.

Today we're introducing achievements, new emotes and music to the game, and we'll kick off the next year with some more exciting changes, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Pandemic Express - Free Weekend Live
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y9Mwc8F.gif[/img]

Good news everyone!

Pandemic Express is currently FREE TO PLAY all weekend! Invite your friends and jump on in. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/939510/Pandemic_Express__Zombie_Escape/

The game is also 34% off during this time. 

[h1]About Pandemic Express[/h1]

If you ever played Zombie Escape mods in Counter-Strike, you know what to expect: a group of players spawns in a confined location. One of them becomes a zombie. Others need to escape as the infected player turns others to the zombie side. Human players frantically loot and try to get to the train where the final showdown happens. 

Humans win by escaping.

Zombies win by infecting everyone. 

The game has a very high skill cap and is focused on using movement & momentum to your advantage. Here's the latest trailer that showcases high skill gameplay:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ilJ02UTK3k0

[h1]Try [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/939510/Pandemic_Express__Zombie_Escape/]Pandemic Express For Free[/url] this weekend[/h1]

notes.title: Bombs and Other Zombie Changes — 13/06/19
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2TI0aGG.gif[/img]

Hey everyone! This week we're [b]reworking the Mimics[/b], making them more distinct from the regular bombers that are currently being reworked. Now instead of exploding mimics can plant bombs! We have also t[b]weaked the Conductor[/b], making them a bit more powerful.

Please find the patch notes below, and don't forget to restart your Steam client if you didn't get the update automatically!

[b]v..0.8.5.000 19/06/13[/b]

notes.title: Conductor Update — 07/06/2019
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/InNZuBO.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

It's been only a day since the last update, and we've already got another one for you!

This time we're introducing a new zombie class — the [b]Conductor[/b].

Conductor is a boss zombie that is given to one random zombie player when the humans are overpowering the zombies.

It's got a ton of health and can't be knocked back by bullets. When it dies, the role is given to another random zombie player, and so on until the situation is more even.

Here's the full patch note:

Have fun!

Please don't forget to restart your Steam client if you didn't receive the update automatically

Here's the full patch note:

[b]v..0.8.2.003 19/05/31[/b]

[i]- New Zombie Respawn system
	- Upon dying, a zombie enters the respawn mode
	- A zombie can spawn anywhere on the map if these conditions are met:
	  1) There are no humans in the zombie's field of view
	  2) The zombie is outside 20m radius of any human
	  3) The zombie isn't on the train

	- A zombie can teleport to a nest by pressing R, same conditions apply

notes.title: Pandemic Express Out Now, 1+1 Promo & Coupons Live
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/ryWXfKW.gif[/img]

Good morning everyone! Pandemic Express is officially live on Steam! So let's get onto a whole bunch of important information and updates! 

[h1]Launch Trailer[/h1]

The launch trailer is now live on Youtube and Steam. Check it out right here: 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VCb-Jd7pEDo

[h1]1+1 Promo (Extra Key For a Friend) promo live[/h1]

For the first 3 days if you buy the game, you get an additional copy to give to a friend! 

[h1]Friend Invite System bumped to URGENT in the roadmap[/h1]

We heard everyone loud and clear and bumped the Friends System up in the roadmap. Checkout the latest one:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/229086c768b3c049b7de0397a8a82586fc7e18b4.png[/img]

[h1]Launch Discount is 34%[/h1]

The game is below $10 at launch

[h1]Additional 10% Coupon Discount[/h1]

If you own one of these tinyBuild games, you get an additional 10% off: Graveyard Keeper, Streets of Rogue, Guts & Glory, Lovely Planet, SpeedRunners Clustertruck, Party Hard 1 or 2. 

[h1]Producer's Note[/h1]

Producer's note on Pandemic Express' journey from Battle Royale to Zombie Escape

This was probably the most bizarre development cycle I've ever had the pleasure to be part of. We started off over 2 years ago trying to make a Battle Royale. Much like everyone at the time. We spent a lot of time iterating on the idea of a more melee focused battle royale, and quickly realized that the fun of looting in an open world doesn't really match well with the idea of using primarily melee weapons. Especially when vehicles are involved. 

Having played a lot of mods back in the day (the team played the original DayZ mod, the original Battle Royale, and a ton of older Counter-Strike mods), we started experimenting. The initial idea was to have a Battle Royale-style game where fallen players would come back as zombies. While fun, it was really confusing and we had to add ranged weapons back to fight off swarms. 

In a fun twist, we saw players organically teaming up while fighting off the swarms. And that was fun. So we pushed it further with putting all survivors -- without any weapons -- into a train station, and randomly infecting one of the players. 

Then we saw a problem with the "goal". Zombie Escape style mods are typically made in corridor-like environments where the path is clear and has logical chokepoints. We had an open world and wanted to maintain the feeling of desperate looting like you have in survival shooters. 

So we opted for a "goal" - a train. Because everyone loves trains and zombies. A train spawns at another station, and is clearly marked as a goal for survivors to get to - by running, sliding, driving -- all while looting through the open world. When survivors are on the train, it starts moving. 

At this point, the zombies start to respawn in front of the train at strategically placed spawners. This gives survivors a feeling of constant onslaught as swarms of zombies attack the train. 

I believe the strangest and most satisfying feeling of Pandemic Express is how non-stressful it is. You get to shoot off zombies after intense scavenging, and when you die, you don't really "lose". You get to experience something different in the match. And you also get to tear through your (5 seconds ago) previous teammates. Because they deserve it. 

If you haven't tried mods like this before - we invite you to try Pandemic Express. It's a different experience, and we hope you like it as much as we do. 

As always, any coverage is highly appreciated and feel free to reach out for additional keys, media materials, or whatever's on your mind. 

Thanks
Alex Nichiporchik
CEO @tinyBuild
For press inquiries contact pr at tinybuild.com

[h1]Enjoy Pandemic Express[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/939510/Pandemic_Express__Zombie_Escape/

notes.title: Final Pre-Launch Patch, Pricing, 1+1 Promo
notes.content:
[img]https://imgur.com/GcnH2j5.gif[/img]

Hi everyone!

We're super excited to be launching Pandemic Express TOMORROW at 9:30am Pacific Time! 

Let's go ahead and run through everything that's happening tomorrow. 

[h1]Launch Trailer[/h1]

Get an early peek at the Launch Trailer

https://youtu.be/VCb-Jd7pEDo

[h1] Alpha Community Keeps The Game [/h1]

Everyone who helped playtest the game (activated their Alpha test) gets to keep the game. Forever. For free. 

Thanks for being part of the community and sharing your love and feedback early on. We really appreciate it <3

[h1] 1+1 Promotion [/h1]

If you haven't participated in the alpha tests — don't worry, we've got something for you as well!

To celebrate the launch, for the first 3 days, anyone who buys Pandemic Express on Steam gets an extra free copy to give to their friends. So go ahead and share the love!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/6afbdbdf60bbcb04488d3d0f042286fec41a6dcc.png[/img]

[h1]Launch Price is under $10[/h1]

The full MSRP for Pandemic Express will be $14.99, however we're launching with a 34% Launch Discount! 

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

If last time you played the game was this Winter or even Fall of last year — there's too many changes to count. If were chasing the survivors just last weekend — here's the list of changes for this week:


v.0.7.9.4.190502
- Fixed sliding animations
- Fixed the bug with the safe zone train stops
- Fixed the main menu UI bugs
- Fixed the server status notification

v.0.7.9.3.190430
- New zombie look
- Major UI overhaul
    - New main menu
    - New match end screens
    - New airdrop UI
    - Changed the color corresponding to health
    - Added armor pickup sign
- Fixed freezes that occurred while connecting to a lobby

[h1]The Road Ahead[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34325804/229086c768b3c049b7de0397a8a82586fc7e18b4.png[/img]

We've got big plans for the game. You can find the roadmap  above, but we'd like to address three major community requests separately.

[b]1) Regional servers[/b]
As of right now, the game's servers are located in Germany. This means that players from the Asia-Pacific region, South America and West Coast of the US might experience latency issues.

We will be closely monitoring the player count in every region, and as soon as we see that regional servers are a viable option, we'll start working on implementing them ASAP. 

[b]2) Playing with your friends[/b]
This is one of the most frequently requested features, it will be added into the game soon. For now — hit "Play" at the same time as your friends, and you should end up in the same lobby.

[b]3) Control rebinds[/b]
Another very important for a competitive game feature. We know it can be a pain, especially if you've used your custom keybinds for years. We'll work on implementing it as soon as we can, but it may take a little longer than the first two.


All aboard the hype train for tomorrow!

notes.title: Welcome to Pandemic Express!
notes.content:
Welcome to our Steam page, comrades! 

Pandemic Express is a "Zombie Escape" mod inspired open world shooter. A team of up to 50 humans spawns in a map, and one of them gets randomly infected. The infected (zombie) player needs to turn everyone to his team by attacking human players. Meanwhile the humans need to escape, by train. 

Checkout the trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pRxoORMhzuM
